result.notes: 250 entries reviewed. No audio was supplied, so all findings are based on text and IPA only. Ordinary American/British variants (rhotic r, /ɑ/ vs /ɔ/, etc.) were not treated as errors. The dataset also has systematic omissions of length marks and bare 'o' for /oʊ/ in many entries; only high-impact or confusable cases are listed. 'Rusia' appears to be a misspelling of Russia rather than a separate pronunciation entry.
